after_logout: Query units/processes and persisted job identities first. If the correct service is active, leave it running; never duplicate it.
Linger=yes user services and the night/day sleep inhibitor are designed to survive logout; this audit did not perform a logout endurance test.
Do not equate a saved waiting_resources/running string with a live service.
after_reboot_or_power_loss: Transient systemd-run user services have no persistent enabled start unit here and Restart=no; no automatic restart is expected. Current boot postdates saved waiter/current status.
Preserve logs, .partial, unverified candidates, prior manifests and all .ok markers. Never present interrupted physical work as a completed or timing-failed strategy.
Generic sweep/matrix resume validates fixed checkpoint/source/code SHA and recovers latest valid .dcp+.ok stage; the interrupted Vivado command must run again from a committed prior stage.
Focused physical campaigns require their own immutable plan/manifest/absolute window and state audit; generic timing_sweep_service.py cannot resume them.

All October21/22 windows have expired. Retaking now requires a separate explicitly authorized fresh window/package based on validated best evidence and preserved pending work. Do not edit old deadlines/manifests to make resume pass.
integrity: CPU RTL/parameters/state/latency must remain within the user-authorized unmodified CPU scope; keep exact clock/constraint/debug coverage and protected-gold hashes.
A timing report with negative setup slack is valid measurement but not closure; hold alone does not close100MHz.
Fresh validation checks setup/hold/pulse, full routing, DRC, constraints, fixed endpoint scope, source/FF/state identity and no new FF/retiming where campaign policy requires.

policies: Preserve checkpoint parents/gold, source snapshots, manifests, independent analyses, launch/job records and report provenance. No blanket rm of experiments or raw .partial while a worker owns them.

Cold text dedup permits only inactive independently reviewed completed jobs, exact SHA/content/perms, only >=1MiB .rpt/.tsv/.xdc in allowed subdirectories. It preserves all paths/content via shared inode; do not edit shared snapshots in place.
Cold report compression was one-off, round-trip gzip SHA verified before removing raw originals; raw-required analyzers may need restoration first. Do not assume .gz is a missing experiment.
Default watcher.py planning writes external audit files; archive_cold_logs.py mutates at top level and must never be imported/executed merely to inspect status.
Do not lower disk reserves to force a run. Current2.17GiB is below normal3GiB startup and3.5GiB retry limits. Restore also needs2.5GiB+uncompressed output.
